results.name: AXE payment methods (backend): no WCAG 2.0/2.1 A/AA violations
M3 "Add New Payment Method" opens an explanation only — no text box for a card number, provider connection NOT STARTED named
M4 "Set as default" on the UPI is PATCH /customer/payment-methods/{id}/default (200): exactly one default, now the UPI; the expired card offers no "Set as default"

M5 no route accepts payment details: POST /customer/payment-methods is 405; a card number in any body is 422 ("FoodOnTheGo never receives payment credentials"); an expired method cannot become default (422 payment_method_not_usable)
M5b the database holds no card number from those attempts
M6 Asha cannot read, default or remove Rahul's methods (empty list / 404)

N1 GET /customer/notification-preferences: 6 categories × 4 channels; ACCOUNT_SECURITY locked on SMS + IN_APP; PROMOTIONS off everywhere (consent never assumed); ORDER_UPDATES e-mail off = Rahul's one explicit choice

N2 the Preferences panel is the backend matrix: a switch per category × channel, security SMS / in-app switches disabled with "Always on", marketing in its own consent section, the inbox labelled development data
AXE notification preferences (backend matrix): no WCAG 2.0/2.1 A/AA violations
N3 switching Offers by Email on is PATCH /customer/notification-preferences (200): the cell is on, marketing consent is timestamped, other PROMOTIONS channels stay off
N3b switching it off again records the withdrawal
N4 switching security notices off by SMS is refused (422 "cannot be switched off"); an unknown category is refused (422)
N5 no page or console errors on payment methods / notifications

results.name: A2 the right code changes the identity: POST /customer/phone-change/verify 200, the profile and GET /auth/me show +919876508888, the page shows the new number
A2b every other session of the account is signed out (the tablet token is 401); this session stays
A2c security events PHONE_CHANGE_REQUESTED and PHONE_CHANGED exist with masked numbers only (no full phone in the metadata)
A3 a number another account uses cannot be requested (409 phone_in_use)

A4 "Request Account Deletion" (confirmation + optional reason) is POST /customer/account/deletion-request (200): the account is RESTRICTED, the request is recorded, nothing is deleted, the session still works, the page says "Request recorded"
A4b a second request changes nothing (idempotent) and the reason never enters the audit trail
A5 on a session older than 30 minutes the deletion request and the phone change answer 403 reauthentication_required — nothing changed

A6 POST /customer/account/reauth sends a code to the account's own phone (masked, purpose reauth, code never returned); a wrong code is 422 otp_invalid; the right one answers reauthenticated with a validity
A6b after the code the sensitive action is allowed (phone-change request 200 for Rahul — not completed, the challenge expires unused)
A7 without a token every /customer route is 401

X1 PII storage audit: the browser keeps the session token (sessionStorage) and no account data — no phone number, name, e-mail, address or payment metadata in localStorage; no mock account keys in API mode
X2 mobile viewport: the account pages render without horizontal overflow
X3 no page or console errors across the account flows
